name: ATM Key Download Response 6
definition: Information related to the response of an ATM key download from an ATM manager.

ATMSecurityContext.name: ATM Security Context
ATMSecurityContext.definition: Context of the ATM for the key download.

ATMChallenge.name: ATM Challenge
ATMChallenge.definition: Random value from the ATM provided during a previous exchange.

HostSecurityParameters.name: Host Security Parameters
HostSecurityParameters.definition: Security parameters of the host downloading the key.

Command.name: Command
Command.definition: Maintenance command to perform on the ATM.
